the expressive power of a Lindström quantifier with respect to a regular language L is the same as the expressive power of the quantifier associated with the double semidirected product of the syntactic monoid of the language with a distinguished set consisting of the generators of the syntactic semigroup of the language.

the Lindstrom quantifiers for a regular language L can be expressed in terms of a double semidirect products of finite monoids and a distinguished set of generating functions, which are the same as the functions that generate the language L.

The main takeaway from our work is that
